checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Straight arms arc from overhead toward feet as torso rises.
checks.feet: Straight legs rise from 5 to 45 degrees together with torso, then lower; pelvis stays supported.
checks.movement: Straight-leg V-up: raise torso and legs together from low extended position, arms arc from overhead toward feet, then lower with control.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Eight-second controlled transition is illustrative, not a prescribed training tempo.
